title: Agile Delivery Steward - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for:**

  

We are looking for an Agile Delivery Steward to drive outcome-oriented delivery in a scaled agile environment. The role focuses on orchestrating value delivery, enabling cross-team flow, and ensuring alignment to product outcomes and organizational agility goals. The candidate should proactively identify, track, and resolve delivery risks, dependencies, and impediments while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

  

**Why this role is important to us:**

  

The team you will be joining is in Global Technology Services (GTS), a function that is vital to the company and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry

  

**As a Agile Delivery Steward, you will be responsible for:**

  

* Manage delivery for value outcomes; align execution to organizational agility; promote transparent, collaborative planning; use delivery metrics traceable to investment; embed OKR and VRM goals into delivery oversight
* Align delivery cadences with product roadmaps and OKRs; ensure predictability and built-in quality.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies, remove impediments, and optimize flow across teams
* Govern delivery flow metrics - throughput, cycle time, and dependency aging
* Facilitate dependency, risk management, escalation and facilitate all hands quarterly planning events
* Capability to mature teams towards behavior driven outcomes
* Coach teams on Definition of Done, engineering practices, and continuous improvement
Configure Jira workflows, automation, and dashboards for delivery transparency  

  

**These skills will help you succeed in this role:**

  
  

***Education & Preferred Qualifications:***

  

* Min a Bachelor’s degree in engineering, product management, business administration, finance or equivalent, and/or other work experience in a technical setting.
* **15-18 years of relevant experience** in Information Technology
* Deep understanding of **Agile delivery, Engineering Enablement** and **Flow optimization**
* Proficient in **tooling ecosystems (Jira, Power Automate, CI/CD telemetry)**
* Productive Use of **Generative AI**
* **LeSS, SAFe RTE, Certified Scrum Master, or Professional Scrum Master certifications.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to communicate verbally with virtual teams on conference calls and to write clear, concise and complete written documentation
* Good organizational skills, ability to move from one task to another efficiently
* Should have good understanding of technologies, process and project milestones.
Ability to work independently on assigned tasks  

  
  

**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**

  

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

  

**Why this role is important to us:**

  

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.

  

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

  

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

  
  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

  
  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

  
  

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

title: Software Engineering Senior Manager- Data Engineering
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Senior Manager to lead development teams working on Corporate Accounting Data applications.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team or teams of experienced engineers and engineering managers in roles with moderate complexity and risk, responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non-functional requirements with each release
* Partner with, engage and influence architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture and enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example cloud readiness, application modernization, data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving escalated resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Determine appropriate strategy and actions to act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to meet moderate to high risk deliverables and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement
* Build engineering skills side-by-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate with, partner with and influence Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources to ensure commitments are met and align with strategic objectives in technology engineering
* Hire, build and guide a culture of talent development to have the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for product areas and products to meet business objectives and strategy, as well as conduct performance management for engineers and managers

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 7+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3+ years of management or leadership experience
* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, including data engineering at enterprise scale Preferred Technical Experience
* 7+ years of experience leading engineering teams or managers.

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* Experience delivering platforms in highly regulated financial services environments
* Strong track record of cross‑functional leadership and execution
* Data technologies: Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Databricks
* Data platforms: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent
* Programming: Java, Python, SQL
* Cloud platforms (Azure, or GCP) with enterprise security controls
* Distributed systems, APIs, and microservices
* Data quality, lineage, reconciliation, and governance frameworks
* DevOps and infrastructure‑as‑code practices
* Lead and develop large, multi‑layered data engineering teams across locations.
* Build a strong leadership bench, succession plans, and a culture of engineering excellence and accountability.
* Act as a trusted technology advisor to senior business, risk, and technology leaders.
* Influence global stakeholders and contribute to enterprise‑wide data strategy and transformation initiatives.

**Job Expectations:**

  

* Strong risk‑aware mindset aligned with Wells Fargo’s culture and values
* Ability to explain complex technical and data concepts to senior business and risk leaders
* Proven ability to influence and lead in a large, matrixed organization
* High standards for engineering discipline, documentation, and operational stability
* Effective leadership during ambiguity, regulatory focus, or high‑visibility initiatives
* **Be Humble:** You're smart yet always interested in learning from others.
* **Work Transparently:** You always deal in an honest, direct, and transparent way.
* **Take Ownership:** You embrace responsibility and find joy in having the answers.
* **Learn More:** You regularly self-educate and improve your skill set.
* **Show Gratitude:** You show appreciation and respect to those you work with.

**Posting End Date:**

27 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Title: Delivery Lead**

The Senior Process Consultant / Delivery Lead is responsible for leading a Sub Value Stream portfolio / Global Programme and driving end-to-end process re-engineering and transformation initiatives to deliver agreed transformation objectives.

The purpose of the Operation Transformation Process Consultant is to support the end-to-end process re-engineering / transformation activities that will deliver transformation goals.

The role requires deep expertise in customer-centric, data-driven process improvement and transformation, covering 4Cs: Customer, Colleague, Cost, Control, and Scalability. The Delivery Lead drives strategic planning and supports Operating Models, governance, tooling, and delivery execution to ensure sustainable business outcomes.

The role also acts as a change catalyst, partnering with Global Business Lines across geographies (primarily home and priority markets) and supporting multiple internal engagements to drive measurable performance improvement.

**In this role, you will:**

* Operate at a Programme delivery level, working for global business and regions and helping the Operations Transformation, business transformation to focus on end customers.
* To deliver the Global Ops transformation programs delivering P&L targets by focusing on the globally directed projects and initiatives by identifying strategic opportunities, designing, implementing, and embedding the change to the operations processes.
* Responsible for leading transformation of different complexities focusing on end-to-end digital journeys with a lens on scalable and reusable solutions and leading other Delivery Leads & Senior Process consultant’s in managing a large transformation program to deliver an agreed set of business objectives.
* Facilitate program governance, RAID management, Fortnightly / Monthly governance packs for Accounts Business Services. Position ID validation with Finance, Anaplan Governance Oversight, Change Request (CRs) Management, JIRA Ticket Housekeeping, Forecast Confidence analysis with Operations Leads by providing a forward view.
* The role requires to oversee and mentor Delivery Leads and Senior process consultants in a program/project environment guiding them to deliver program/project objectives
* For specific functional areas, deliver step change in operational performance (cost, service levels, and customer satisfaction) through identification and successful initiation of new process improvement initiatives aligned with local/regional transformation goals.
* Act as a strategic transformation delivery lead focusing on operational excellence & working closing with stakeholders to identify key projects. Provide detail input to ensure commercially viable decisions are taken on prioritizing and optimizing the project portfolio.
* Work closely with different transformation programme and providing on ground support from DBS Operations transformation perspective with Revisit projects post deployment on regular basis to validate whether the objectives are met and sustainable
* Be knowledgeable of key business drivers – WFM data, process maps, process insights, data intelligence etc. Also Organize & lead process reviews, walkthrough, bootcamp sessions.
* Mobilize right support for reengineering projects and ensuring designs are translated into implementation- including Tech funding ask, Business case creation, supporting Jira work for demand intake process.
* Anticipate issues and risks and address them quickly, with an understanding of the critical path. Contemplate contingencies and develop strategies to manage risks and collaborate with other enablers & teams i.e. Automation, Technology, Operation Transformation Program Office to drive Global and local re-engineering initiatives

**Leadership & Teamwork:**

**Value Creation:**

* Own value creation planning, ensuring benefits, scope, schedule, and costs are clearly defined, tracked, and realized.
* Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, customer experience, control effectiveness, and scalability.
* Use data-driven insights to assess performance, validate outcomes post-deployment, and drive continuous improvement.
* Balance speed, risk, and value to ensure sustainable delivery outcomes.

**Operational Performance:**

* Provide hands-on delivery oversight, ensuring projects meet milestones, quality standards, and financial commitments.
* Review and challenge delivery plans, resourcing models, and execution approaches to maximize effectiveness.
* Drive standardization through use of approved templates, tools, and delivery methodologies.
* Ensure post-implementation reviews are conducted and lessons learned are embedded into future delivery.

**People and Capability Development:**

* Identify capability gaps and work with Programme Directors to secure appropriate skills and resources.
* Set clear expectations, roles, and accountability for delivery team members.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance team environment.
* Act as a role model for delivery excellence

**To be successful you will:**

**Experience**

* 10 to 15 years of experience in operations transformation, operations strategy, programme delivery, and change management, ideally within financial services.
* Domain understanding of overall banking and financial/consulting services industry especially Private banking & Wealth knowledge will be preferred.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi-country and multi-stakeholder programmes.
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and drive decisions in ambiguous environments.
* Experience working across global operating models and matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success in delivering measurable business outcomes across cost, efficiency, customer experience, and control.
* Be a strong team player and contribute to the success of teamwork, taking up different roles and activities.
* Track-record of leading Agile multi-disciplined teams to deliver exceptional customer service and value.
* Preferably Black Belt trained / certified, Agile coach & scrum master certification
* Strong problem-solving skills using end to end process reviews and data driven analysis.
* Exposure / experience to Microsoft Power Platform, AI and other automations tools / techniques will be an added
* Understand business case, challenge benefit quantification, and do reality check.
* Strong communications, leadership, project management, influencing, analytical, decision-making, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of Process Excellence methodology- proficiency in conducting workshops and working with stakeholders for strategic planning.

**Capabilities**

* Portfolio / Value Stream Definition and Planning
* Programme Management
* Global Mindset
* Customer Empathy
* Practical working knowledge of agile
* Business Commerciality
* Business Analysis and Design
* Resource and Team Management and Leadership
* Problem Solving and Critical Thinking
* Innovation and Idea Management
* Ability to navigate a complex stakeholder matrix

title: Scrum Master
description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.  
  
By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.  
  
From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Scrum Masters enable the implementation of scrum framework and its principles, values, and practices within a squad. The role acts as a servant leader who helps their teams to deliver value incrementally in a collaborative manner. They are aligned to one or two squads.

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

* Acts as a servant leader by serving the needs of the Scrum Team, removing obstacles, and empowering team members to take ownership of their work.
* Promotes continuous improvement by facilitating Sprint Retrospectives, identifying opportunities, and implementing action plans.
* Encourages reflection on processes and supports incremental changes.
* Continuously develops personal knowledge and skills by engaging with Scrum communities, attending training, obtaining certifications, and seeking feedback.
* Coaches the Scrum Team on Scrum practices, principles, and values, fostering self-organization and continuous improvement.
* Facilitates collaboration and communication within the team and with stakeholders, promoting transparency and a culture of openness and trust.
* Encourages cross-functional collaboration between Development Teams and other groups.
* Supports the Product Owner in managing the Product Backlog, refining User Stories, and prioritizing work to maximize value.
* Supports up to one Squad by facilitating group activities or workshops in complex and ambiguous situations with competing stakeholder needs.
* Designs structured sequences of meetings, events, or workshops to solve complex problems.
* Understands required outcomes and guides the team to deliver them.
* Facilitates all Scrum events—Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives—ensuring they are effective, focused, and time-boxed.
* Removes impediments by identifying blockers, collaborating with stakeholders, and resolving issues proactively. Protects the team from external distractions during the Sprint.
* Helps improve team processes and performance in meetings, events, or workshops.
* Ensures Scrum artifacts such as the Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, and Burndown Charts are transparent and up-to-date by working closely with the Product Owner and Development Team.
* Provides key metrics to senior stakeholders to maintain visibility into progress and priorities.

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are to be regarded as broad areas of responsibility and do not necessarily detail all tasks which the post holder may be required to perform.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills, Capabilities and Attributes**

The ideal candidate will have the below skills, capabilities and attributes essential or preferred.

* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Agile Methodologies - Scrum/Kanban
* Awareness of Scaling
* Leading, educating, and coaching
* Efficiency improvement
* Documentation
* Lifecycle management
* Problem solving

**Measures of success**

* Improves team flow and delivery predictability through effective Scrum facilitation and coaching practices.
* Drives continuous improvement through retrospectives, actionable insights and measurable team outcomes.
* Removes impediments quickly while protecting team focus and enabling consistent Sprint delivery.
* Strengthens collaboration, transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders consistently.
* Ensures Scrum artefacts are accurate, visible and support informed decision-making effectively.
* Supports Product Owner to refine backlog, improving clarity, prioritisation and delivery value.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**  
  
As a Principal Consultant (Delivery Enterprise Architect) within the Dell organization, aligned to Consulting Service Delivery, you will provide consultative business and technical delivery services for a range of complex customer-facing consulting engagements, in partnership with Global Pre-Sales, Account Management and Solutioning Teams. Specifically, you will be part of projects deploying, administering and configurating Large Language Model and Generative AI software stacks. These projects will focus on allowing Dell customers to deploy and fine-tune GenAI models.  
  
Also, as the senior-most technical member of the Services Delivery team, for the GenAI/Data Science Practice, you will work alongside other Dell badged Consultants, to earn the customers trust through competence, technical acumen, consulting expertise, and partnership. You would also be responsible for providing guidance/oversight to these individuals and technical grooming activities for their skill upgrading. This position requires a dynamic individual with expert customer-facing skills, leadership qualities and forecasting abilities for a particular technology and its lifecycle. The ability to guide customers and communicate technical processes and ideas is essential. These engagements often ensure that the customer is also enabled in the technologies being delivered.  
  
The person should have the common traits and capabilities that are listed in Section 2 (Essential Requirements) and meet many of the capabilities listed in Section 3 (Desirable Requirements).  
  
**Key Requirements:**  
  
**Experience and qualifications:**  
  

* 18+ years in the IT industry, preferably with a masters degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* 8+ years in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data within a customer-facing services delivery role, including the ability to engage Data Scientists and assess their current and future ecosystems.
* 5+ years implementing and supporting infrastructure deployment, setup, and configuration through automation (agentic automation a strong plus).

  
**Generative & Agentic AI:**  
  

* Deep, hands-on knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the broader Generative AI tooling ecosystem.
* Proven experience designing agentic AI solutions and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, Langfuse, and LangSmith.
* Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI software suite, including NVIDIA Base Command Manager (formerly Bright Cluster Manager), the NeMo framework, and Triton Inference Server.

  
**MLOps & AIOps Platforms:**  
  

* Deep understanding of the MLOps and AIOps ecosystem, with hands-on experience across platforms such as Kubeflow, MLflow, Run:ai, ClearML, Ray, H2O, and Cohere.

  
**Data Engineering & Distributed Systems:**  
  

* Extensive production experience with distributed query and processing engines Kafka, Trino (Starburst) and Apache Spark.
* Hands-on experience with modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) for managing large-scale datasets.
* Mastery of cloud-native storage and compute e.g., AWS S3/EMR, GCP BigQuery/Dataproc, or Azure ADLS/Databricks.
* Deep understanding of columnar storage formats (Parquet, Avro) and how to optimize them for different query patterns.

  
**DevOps, IaC & CI/CD:**  
  

* Proven application of DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across both application development and infrastructure automation including desired-state configuration, GitOps, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Extensive experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab, Argo CD, and Tekton.

  
**Kubernetes & Containers:**  
  

* Proven experience deploying and configuring Kubernetes (e.g., OpenShift), with deep knowledge of application deployments, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
* Extensive experience building containerized applications, including container image signing.
* Knowledge of AI-related Kubernetes operators, such as the NVIDIA GPU, Network, and Storage operators.

  
**Consulting & Delivery Skills:**  
  

* Ability to earn customer trust and to plan, organize, and lead customer workshops; excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Comfortable working in efficient Agile teams (Scrum or Kanban), including extended pairing and enablement sessions that drive knowledge transfer in complex domains.
* Ability to influence and interact with confidence and credibility at all levels within Dell and across customers, partners, and vendors.
* Experience delivering within a defined project methodology while adhering to SOW, margin, and planning requirements.
* Willingness and ability to be onsite for customer workshops and enablement sessions.

title: DATA CONSULTANT I-INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

**DATA CONSULTANT I – INDIA**

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Should have 2-5 years of experience in DWBI
* Should have good knowledge of data warehousing concepts and data visualization best practices
* Should have good knowledge of Azure Databricks, Informatica, Oracle, SQL Server, PLSQL, SQL, MSBI, performance tuning, PowerBI
* Excellent analytical skills
* Own proof of concept activities
* Contribute towards CoE
* Understand business domain and provide insights
* Ability to deploy automations via ETL pipelines and visualization environments
* Job involves, 16x7 Shifts (Sunday to Saturday, 365 days, India day time)
* Ability to code, unit test, support system testing and user acceptance.
* Contribute as trainer at org level as and when needed
* Awareness of configuration management and release process.
* Ability to analyze data issues, production issues, performance issues etc.
* SDLC Knowledge: awareness of the SDLC process.
* Desire to learn about a rapidly changing industry tools and technology
* Ability to align / work with Org initiatives quickly
* Should be strong collaborator and coordinator

title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:

Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.



Summary

Candidates with experience in **healthcare data analytics and US Healthcare systems** will be preferred.

### **Qualification**

title: Data Architect
description:
### **Job Title**

Data Architect
### **Job Description**

**Job Responsibilities:**  

* Executes robust data strategies, adapting them to align with evolving business requirements and operational needs while coordinating with cross\-functional teams to ensure strategic alignment and feasibility, working under limited supervision.
* Handles the execution of complex data requests and queries, employing advanced analytical techniques to derive actionable insights and support decision\-making processes effectively.
* Helps to safeguard the integrity of data outputs and reports through rigorous verification, validation, and adherence to established quality standards, implementing data quality frameworks and monitoring data health metrics proactively.
* Optimizes scalable data pipeline architectures, assembling and managing extensive datasets crucial for Post Market Analytics and other strategic initiatives, implementing best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and storage.
* Documents and ensures compliance with comprehensive statistical\-based trending procedures, maintaining transparency and readiness for regulatory audits, and developing and maintaining documentation of data processes, methodologies, and compliance measures.
* Handles end\-to\-end data processes with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and integrity, optimizing system designs and business logic rules for operational efficiency, and overseeing data loading, maintenance, and performance tuning activities.
* Collaborates with the scrum team to finalize the design of user stories, ensuring they align with the overall architecture and development goals, and takes part in code reviews and maintaining code quality.
* Provides continuous guidance and coaching to the scrum team on design knowledge and best practices, and might participate in code development activities to uphold high standards of software quality.
* Possesses a comprehensive understanding of software development and design principles, which enables effective problem\-solving and innovative solutions within the development team.
* Engages with team\-level stakeholders, including Senior Software Architects and the Product Owners, to ensure clear communication and effective collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
* Focuses on the integration and functionality of components within the larger system architecture, ensuring that each part contributes effectively to the overall system performance.
* Plans Program Increments (PI) with a typical time horizon of three months, which involves detailed scheduling, resource allocation, and strategic progress towards achieving development targets.
* Holds responsibility for architecture and requirements at the feature level, ensuring they meet the desired outcomes, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations within the broader project context.
* Ensures comprehensive, up\-to\-date, and usable documentation of the software architecture in compliance with regulatory standards and organizational processes.
* Understands and effectively applies the development logic of the I2M architecture and platform creation process, ensuring seamless interfacing with Application Development (AD) and Product Data Lifecycle Management (PDLM) suites.

**Key Responsibilties**

* Design and implement end\-to\-end **cloud\-native data architectures** on AWS to support serviceability analytics, monitoring, and predictive insights.
* Develop scalable **data pipelines** using AWS Glue, Lambda and other AWS services.
* Define workflow for **data ingestion** , **cleansing** , **transformation** , and **storage** using S3, Athena, Glue and other AWS services.
* Ensure **data security** , **compliance** , and **governance** .
* Implement robust **monitoring** and **alerting mechanisms** using CloudWatch and custom metrics for pipeline health and data quality.
* Contribute to **cloud optimization** , cost control, and architectural design reviews.

**Minimum required Education:**

Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Data Analytics, Statistical Techniques, Mathematics, Computer Science or equivalent.
  

  

**Minimum required Experience:**  

Minimum 8\+ years of experience with Bachelor's in areas such as Software Development, Software Design and Architecture, Testing and Quality Assurance or equivalent  



  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS S3** , **Lambda** , **Athena** , **S3** , **API Gateway** , **CloudFront** , **ECS** and **Glue** .
* Solid understanding of **data modeling** , **partitioning strategies** , and **performance tuning** in large datasets.
* Familiarity with tools like **CloudFormation** for infrastructure automation.
* Proficiency in **Python** and **SQL**
* Knowledge of **serviceability domain** use cases such as diagnostics, telemetry, and predictive service operations is a plus.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Data Analysis \& Interpretation
* Data Governance
* Data Harmonization \& Processing
* Data Quality Assurance
* Statistical Methods
* Statistical Programming Software
* Business Intelligence Tools
* Regulatory Compliance

  

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Senior Project Leader Software
description:
Are you passionate about leading complex embedded software programs at the intersection of hardware and software? We are looking for an experienced **Embedded Software Project Manager** with deep expertise in **Device Driver development** and a proven ability to navigate low\-level hardware constraints while driving end\-to\-end project execution.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* An Embedded Software Project Manager specializing in Device Drivers must possess a unique hybrid skillset, bridging the gap between low\-level hardware constraints and high\-level project execution.
* They are responsible for managing timelines, cross\-functional teams, and the architectural risks inherent to low\-level hardware abstraction.

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science
* 8\+ years of total experience in embedded systems, including at least 3\+ years in a technical leadership or project management role.
* A proven track record of designing, developing, and debugging device drivers
* Standard PM credentials like PMP (Project Management Professional) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) are highly preferred.
* Ability to manage project dependencies where code cannot be completed or tested until silicon, prototypes, or Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) simulators are ready
* Proficiency in mixing Agile methodologies (for iterative driver features) with Waterfall milestones (aligned with rigid physical hardware tape\-outs and manufacturing deadlines)
* Defining alternative timelines if custom chips or silicon samples arrive late or display physical defects.
* Managing specialized engineers (e.g., separating the application layer team from the hardware abstraction layer team).

  

\#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.


Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
